name: caustics
title: Caustics
description: The shifting net of light on the floor of a sunlit pool: thin filaments that meet in hot spots and wobble over dim water.

name: voronoi
title: Voronoi Cells
description: A cellular surface like soap foam, crackle glaze or raised stone tiles, with walls of one width and seeds that drift so cells swell, shrink and trade edges.

name: flow-field
title: Flow field
description: A wind map: streamlines of a slowly turning, swirling flow, with bright streaks that travel along them and leave fading tails.
